title: DOM Manipulation
description: Interacting with the Document Object Model using JavaScript.

lessons.title: What is the DOM?
lessons.content: The Document Object Model (DOM) is a programming interface that represents the structure of an HTML or XML document as a tree of objects. It allows scripts to update content, structure, and styles dynamically.

lessons.title: Selecting Elements
Changing Content
Changing Styles
Creating and Adding Elements
Removing Elements
Event Listeners
Event Delegation
lessons.content: Event delegation allows you to attach a single event listener to a parent element to manage events for its child elements, improving performance and simplifying code.

lessons.title: Manipulating Classes
Traversing the DOM
lessons.content: DOM traversal methods allow you to navigate between elements, accessing parents, children, and siblings to manipulate related nodes efficiently.
